name: robotattack
description: Human game server and control panel for RobotAttack.

scripts.test: sh -c 'mkdir -p logs; ts=$(date +%F_%H-%M-%S); jest --runInBand 2>&1 | tee logs/test-$ts.log | tee logs/test-latest.log > /dev/null'
scripts.test:integration: sh -c 'mkdir -p logs; ts=$(date +%F_%H-%M-%S); jest tests/integration --runInBand 2>&1 | tee logs/test-integration-$ts.log | tee logs/test-integration-latest.log > /dev/null'
